description: This file contains a class 'RunwayMLImageGenerationConfig' that manages configuration, request transformation, response handling, and polling logic for interfacing with the RunwayML API for image generation tasks within a larger AI/ML project. It includes methods for constructing URLs, validating environment variables, transforming responses, polling task status both synchronously and asynchronously, and mapping OpenAI-like parameters to RunwayML-specific parameters.
